## THE STORY ### A deli for everyone. Every single thing — plant-based. A.T.M. Vegan Deli is a Brooklyn deli where the entire menu is 100% plant-based — no exceptions, no fine print. We took the classic NYC deli format and rebuilt it from the ground up with whole-food ingredients, house-made proteins, and serious technique. Classic deli sandwiches. Crisp salads. Satisfying sides. All vegan, all day. You'll notice our menu items go by three-letter codes — **B.E.C., R.B.N., C.H.P., T.N.A.** — our playful nod to deli shorthand and the classic bacon-egg-and-cheese ticket-counter tradition. Each code is a whole meal waiting to happen. We're located in Clinton Hill / Bed-Stuy at 525 DeKalb Ave. Come hungry.
